variants.about_this_item:
A diet rich in protein promotes lean muscle mass and a healthy body weight, while keeping your dog satisfied and happy. ACANA™ Light & Fit is brimming with fresh meat*, organs and bone from chicken and wild-caught flounder, plus the delicious nutrition of eggs.

1. 65%** QUALITY ANIMAL INGREDIENTS | PROTEIN-RICH & NUTRIENT-DENSE
2. 1/3 OF ANIMAL INGREDIENTS ARE FRESH OR RAW POULTRY AND FISH
3. 3 ANIMAL PROTEIN VARIETIES | FROM SUPPLIERS WE KNOW AND TRUST
4. WHOLEPREY | POULTRY, FISH, ORGANS AND BONE
5. FREEZE-DRY INFUSED | INTENSE NATURAL FLAVOUR
6. WHOLE VEGETABLES, FRUIT & BOTANICALS | FRESH
7. NO GRAIN INGREDIENTS***


*Our fresh ingredients use refrigeration as the sole method of preservation and our raw ingredients are frozen at the peak of freshness to preserve nutrients.
**Approximate and derived from the unprocessed state of the ingredients.
*** Produced in a facility that processes grains
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition

Fresh chicken (20.5%), chicken meal (20%), whole red lentils, whole green peas, pea fiber, fresh chicken giblets (liver, heart) (5%), turkey meal (5%), herring meal (4%), eggs (4%), raw flounder (4%), whole chickpeas, whole green lentils, whole yellow peas, pea starch, chicken fat (1%), fish oil (1%), raw turkey livers (0.5%), salt, dried kelp, fresh whole pumpkin, fresh whole butternut squash, fresh whole carrots, fresh whole apples, fresh whole pears, fresh whole zucchini, dried chicory root, fresh kale, fresh spinach, fresh turnip greens, fresh beet greens, fresh whole cranberries, fresh whole blueberries, fresh whole saskatoon berries, turmeric, milk thistle, burdock root, lavender, marshmallow root, rosehips.

Analytical constituents

Crude protein 35% Fat content 11% Crude fibre 8% Crude ash 7% Moisture 12% Calcium 1.7% Phosphorus 1.1% Omega-3 fatty acids 0.9% Omega-6 fatty acids 2.2% DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) 0.3% EPA (eicosapentaenoic acid) 0.3%
